== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Stellar Spear]] [[madra]] is a specialized form of energy used by practitioners on the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]]. This power is characterized by its white, snow-like appearance and its association with light and sword aspects. It can manifest as physical-looking weapons, such as glowing spears or multiple spectral reflections that strike simultaneously, and can be used to reinforce a user's weapon through techniques like [[Star's Edge]]. The [[madra]] is capable of producing intense [[sword aura]] that can cause significant physical destruction, such as peeling flesh from bone. Additionally, the [[madra]] is linked to [[Remnants]]—bony, starlight-like entities that can rise from the environment. While it is highly effective for combat and conducting willpower, it also possesses the ability to disrupt or break other techniques.}}
